ana: Heads-up — Prospect (CivicTrust) wants an air-gapped POC but with a 6-month upgrade freeze window after initial install. They also want FedRAMP-matching SBOM, signed artifacts, and a documented chain-of-custody. Can SE/ops confirm constraints?

kevin: We can provide a gold-image / immutable bundle pinned at delivery. Important notes:
- If they require a freeze (no updates) we still recommend security delta minibundles for critical CVEs; delivering those would be a billable exception to the freeze.
- Gold image size ~20-60GB depending on model.

omar: Delivery modes: full operator tar or encrypted minibundle on tamper-sealed USB/DVD. Courier lead time ~3-6bd. We can also provide signed manifest + CycloneDX SBOM. If customer wants to retain private signing keys in HSM, we do verification-only workflow (they import public key), otherwise we sign and provide signatures.

katie: Legal: FedRAMP-like ask means we must be explicit about telemetry (they requested no outbound by default) and retention. We'll draft SOW language: "no beacon" + emergency-patch carve-out + chain-of-custody acceptance criteria. Also call out re-signing on key rotation as an operational exception.

kevin: Short acceptance checklist for their SecOps (send as 6 bullets):
- sha256sum matches manifest
- signature verifies against provided CA cert
- SBOM (CycloneDX) validates against artifact
- Dry-run install on isolated node (no egress)
- Confirm telemetry flags disabled in config
- Confirm golden-image hash and note rollback procedure

omar: Copyable commands to include:

sha256sum redwood-goldbundle-2026.tar.gz
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature redwood-goldbundle.sig redwood-goldbundle-2026.tar.gz
cyclonedx validate --sbom redwood-goldbundle-sbom.json --artifact redwood-goldbundle-2026.tar.gz
cat manifest.json | jq '.images[] | {name,digest}'

ana: Pricing question — is this a one-off packaging + courier fee or ongoing?

katie: Recommend: one-time packaging & signing fee (includes SBOM) + per-shipment courier cost. If they want periodic approved minibundles during freeze (security exceptions) add a monthly retainer or per-incident hotfix fee (we usually offer 48h hotfix SLA as paid add-on). Also +15-25% uplift if telemetry-disabled increases manual support surface or if they require HSM integration PS days.

omar: Operational gotchas to call out to customer:
- signer key rotation triggers re-signing active bundles (timeline & cost)
- delta minibundles require operator-version pinning in manifest
- offline acceptance requires an on-site or remote-guided dry-run (we can provide an SE at daily rate)
- chain-of-custody: tamper seals + serialed media + signed courier manifest recommended

ship-bot: Created ticket POC-CT-1886 and attached internal runbook. Assigned to omar + kevin.

ana: Great — I'll draft the SecOps email with the 6-bullet checklist + commands + pricing options and ask them to confirm whether they want strict freeze (no exceptions) or freeze with paid emergency patch path. Closing thread once sent. :white_check_mark:
